name: Cultist: Y'Shaarj's Enforcer doubles Twilight Shieldtoss damage and removes its bounce (#1277)
contract: 803236 effect 0 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100%; effect 1 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), EffectMiscValue 17 = SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, EffectBasePoints -4 + DieSides 1 = -3; both share EffectSpellClassMask word1 bit 16384. Twilight Shieldtoss rank 804208 (the rank AscensionSpellProgressionData.h grants a level-18..25 Cultist for base id 524876) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags (0, 16384, 0) - exact match - Effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE and EffectChainTarget 3. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:9365-9369, what the spell_damage_done metric queries with a fixed base of 1000) applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE to the computed damage at the very end, so a caster with 803236 known must see exactly double the damage bonus of a caster without it. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1884-1906) reads ChainTarget (3), applies SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS through the same spell_modifier path, and only chains when the modified value exceeds 1; 3 + (-3) = 0, so Twilight Shieldtoss no longer bounces at all. 803236 is not in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 collision table, so the plain classmask match applies directly to every Twilight Shieldtoss rank, including 804208. 500712 (Ancient Curse, SpellFamilyFlags all zero, itself a Cultist SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE spell) is the negative control for both the damage percent and the chain-target flat modifier. Numbers read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer, and the collision-table absence was confirmed by reading SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod directly (SpellInfo.cpp ~1494-1509). No script or SQL references 803236. This scenario never casts Twilight Shieldtoss (avoiding its own damage-roll randomness, EffectBasePoints 125 + DieSides 11): both halves are queried directly through native calculation entry points. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
